pair_rule: all legal same-view two-camera pairs in each listed scene; no error or metric selection

vfuse_best.role: epoch6 internal best, fixed before heldout scoring

vfuse_last.role: epoch30 last, sensitivity only; cannot replace best

geometry.units: millimetres for scoring and V-FUSE range
geometry.source_to_target: existing fixed T_camera2_camera1; source D435 to target L515; translation converted m->mm as formal adapter
geometry.intrinsics: existing fixed per-camera intrinsics resized to 320x240
geometry.projection: nearest-Z target splat, round floor(u+0.5), positive finite valid depth only
geometry.evaluation_region: target published GT mask after nearest-neighbor resize; all valid nonzero GT pixels; unchanged
geometry.upper_projection: common target raw upper projection: finite positive target raw <=10m => min(pred,target raw), fixed and applied to every method
geometry.fixed_threshold: none selected or changed in heldout; no GT-driven threshold/depth-range change
geometry.search_range_source: fit-only fixed range from formal V-FUSE run; heldout GT cannot change it
